question: If the interest on a sum of Rs. y at 4% per annum compounded annually for 2 years is ₹612, then the total amount payable at the end of the two-year period will be _________.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount (P) = Rs. y

Rate of interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

Interest (I) = Rs. 612

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula:

A = P(1 + (R)/(100))^T

Where, A = Total amount payable

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest

T = Time
